mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_code ( code_id, code_group_id, code, code_name, code_value, sort_order, use_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{codeId}, #{codeGroupId}, #{code}, #{codeName}, #{codeValue}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_code SET code_group_id=#{codeGroupId}, code=#{code}, code_name=#{codeName}, code_value=#{codeValue}, sort_order=COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), use_yn=COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE code_id = #{codeId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_code SET delete_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code_id = #{codeId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_code WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
